1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein __the stiffening microstructure is structurally distinct from the conductive paths and is not a conductive path__.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening __and does not extend into the conductive paths__.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening __and is laterally offset from the conductive paths__.

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __and has a height greater than the thickness of the chip mounting surface__.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and the opening is formed prior to application of the solder mask layer__.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer __and the stiffening microstructure is in direct contact with the exposed portion of the core layer__.

7. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes__ a lid.

9. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __having a hollow interior__.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure __at a location distinct from the conductive paths__.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device __communicatively__ coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein __the stiffening microstructure is structurally distinct from conductive paths within the packaging structure__.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening __and is laterally isolated from signal conductive paths__.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __and provides mechanical support independent of electrical signal routing__.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and the opening is formed prior to solder mask application__.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer __and the stiffening microstructure contacts the exposed core layer__.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is one of a ring __having a hollow interior__ or a lid.

20. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with ground reference plane layer.
